notes.title: Release Announcement! Steam Cloud Check.
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Everyone! 
Siluman here!

We’re super excited to share that [b]Monmusu Paradise Visitor[/b] is ready for release, but there’s might be a slight delay. The [b]Cloud Save[/b] feature is still waiting for confirmation from [b]Steam[/b] before we can roll it out.
I am sorry for the inconvenience and we will release the game ASAP when we are cleared by the system so you can enjoy our world. *The updates will follow after as we promised too.[/p][p]Unfortunately, this delay is might because a lot of things happened, but we're positively hope everything will be alright going forward.[/p][p]We’re working hard to ensure everything is properly sorted out as soon as possible. We truly appreciate your patience and support as we navigate this process, and we’ll keep you updated with any new developments![/p][p]Stay tuned, and thank you again for your understanding![/p][p]
Best,

Siluman[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 WE DID IT! Final Test Complete for Monmusu Paradise ~ Visitor ~ 🎉

I’m [b]thrilled to announce[/b] that the [b]final test for Monmusu Paradise ~ Visitor ~[/b] is officially [b]complete[/b]! The game is looking better than ever, and I couldn't be more excited for you all to experience it! 💖[/p][p]From the demo, we have added :

- As promised 9 scenes is fully implemented!

Currently we're working on final polish related with audio, translations and Credits,
We have given Supporters to try the game using the keys we have sent, if you're inclined to.

Once again thanks for your patience and we'll polish and update this game the best we can.[/p]

notes.title: Monmusu Paradise ~ Visitor ~ Demo Now Available! 🎮
notes.notes:
Hello, Guys!!!
We’re excited to announce that the Monmusu Paradise ~ Visitor ~ demo is officially LIVE! 🎉

The demo is available for everyone to try, but Supporters will get 2 weeks of early access to the full game before the official release! 🥳

What’s in the Demo?
🎣 Fishing Minigame: Relax and catch some surprises!

🏝️ Cozy Resort Music: Chill out with soothing vibes while you explore.

👀 Meet the Heroines, and unlock 3 of 9 scenes we have prepared for you guys!
Get a glimpse of the personalities and designs you’ll encounter in the full game.

How to Play:

Supporters get 2 weeks of early access to the full game soon!
Visit our social media for more information!
[url=https://x.com/silumansoft]https://x.com/silumansoft[/url]

The demo is available for everyone to try starting NOW!
But the full game will be available to the public after 2 weeks of early access for supporters.

Why Play the Demo?
We want your feedback! Your thoughts on gameplay, mechanics, and characters will help us refine and improve the final release. We’d love to hear what you think!

Stay Tuned!
Thank you so much for your support! We’re excited to share the full game with you all in a couple of weeks. Until then, enjoy the demo and let us know your thoughts! 💖

PS: Don't forget that we have the ongoing campaign to add more content for free!!!
Wishlist the game now so we can reach that target!
